page.overview:
Who is Solemn Gus?

Gus, better known as Solemn Gus, is a character in the Final Fantasy VII series. He is a minor supporting antagonist in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth.

Gus is the flamboyant, slick, and sleazy kingpin of Corel Prison in the Dustbowl. He leads a rowdy gang of hooligans and keeps tabs on the underworld, mostly operating as an informant.

Solemn Gus is based on Mr. Coates from Final Fantasy VII.

Gus was born in 1973. Sometime after the Gold Saucer staff abandoned their housing in the Dustbowl due to frequent monster attacks, Gus and his gang of ruffians took over the area. He renamed it Corel Prison and established his base in the largest building, which he called the "Solemnity Mansion".
